::: {#exm-second-moment-bernoulli}

#### The second moment of a Bernoulli random variable

Let $Z \sim \Ber(\prob)$.
Then $\E{Z^2} = \prob$ directly,
because $Z^2 = Z$ when $Z$ is $0$ or $1$.
The [lemma](#lem-second-moment-variance) gives the same value
from the [mean](expectation.qmd#def-expectation) and the [variance](#def-variance):

$$
\ba
\var{Z} + \sqf{\E{Z}}
&= \prob(1 - \prob) + \prob^2
&& \text{(Bernoulli variance and mean)} \\
&= \prob
&& \text{(expand and combine like terms)}
\ea
$$

:::
